41182-mrs-maxon-protests.creator: Unknown
41182-mrs-maxon-protests.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. But you must see it's far too long, besides being, as I say, horribly impartial. So I took to calling it by a pet name of my own. That makes it come over to my side.

arxiv-1907-02328.title: Constraining neutrino mass and dark energy with peculiar velocities and lensing dispersions of Type Ia supernovae
arxiv-1907-02328.creator: Aniket Agrawal, Teppei Okumura, Toshifumi Futamase
arxiv-1907-02328.description: Abstract We show that peculiar velocities of Type Ia supernovae can be used to derive constraints on the sum of neutrino masses, Σ ​ m ν \Sigma m_{\nu} , and dark energy equation of state, w = w 0 + w a ​ ( 1 − a ) w=w_{0}+w_{a}(1-a) , from measurements of the magnitude-redshift relation, complementary to galaxy redshift

arxiv-2011-08118.title: On Cross Hyperoperatorial Migration of Properties, Related to Natural Number Division Operator
arxiv-2011-08118.creator: V. Sh. Tlyusten, V. B. Tlyachev
arxiv-2011-08118.description: Abstract In the article integer divisibility properties and related prime factors natural number representation concepts have been defined over the whole infinite hyperoperation hierarchy. The definitions have been made across and above of unique arithmetic operations, composing this hierarchy (addition, multiplication, exponentiation, tetration and so on).

arxiv-2106-03680.title: Variational Hamiltonian Simulation for Translational Invariant Systems via Classical Pre-Processing
arxiv-2106-03680.creator: Refik Mansuroglu, Timo Eckstein, Ludwig Nützel, Samuel A. Wilkinson, Michael J. Hartmann
arxiv-2106-03680.description: Abstract The simulation of time evolution of large quantum systems is a classically challenging and in general intractable task, making it a promising application for quantum computation. A Trotter-Suzuki approximation yields an implementation thereof, where a higher approximation accuracy can be traded for an increased gate count.

arxiv-2305-11174.title: Magnetic catalysis in weakly interacting hyperbolic Dirac materials
arxiv-2305-11174.creator: Bitan Roy
arxiv-2305-11174.description: Abstract Due to the linearly vanishing density of states, emergent massless Dirac quasiparticles resulting from the free fermion motion in a family of two-dimensional half-filled bipartite hyperbolic lattices feature dynamic mass generation through quantum phase transitions only for sufficiently strong finite-range Coulomb repulsion.

arxiv-2307-15631.title: Exploring Moral Principles Exhibited in OSS: A Case Study on GitHub Heated Issues Conference: The 31st ACM Joint European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software Engineering; 11 - 17 November, 2023; San Francisco, USA DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1
arxiv-2307-15631.creator: Ramtin Ehsani, Rezvaneh Rezapour, Preetha Chatterjee
arxiv-2307-15631.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ramtin Ehsani, Rezvaneh Rezapour, Preetha Chatterjee. To foster collaboration and inclusivity in Open Source Software (OSS) projects, it is crucial to understand and detect patterns of toxic language that may drive contributors away, especially those from underrepresented communities. Although machine learning-based toxicity detection tools trained on domain-specific data have shown promise, their design lacks an understanding of the unique nature and triggers of toxicity in OSS discussions, highlighting the need for further investigation.

arxiv-2409-17795.title: Physics-driven complex relaxation for multi-body systems of SPH method Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2409-17795.creator: Chenxi Zhao, Yongchuan Yu, Oskar J. Haidn, Xiangyu Hu
arxiv-2409-17795.description: Abstract In the smoothed particle dynamics (SPH) method, the characteristics of a target particle are interpolated based on the information from its neighboring particles. Consequently, a uniform initial distribution of particles significantly enhances the accuracy of SPH calculations. This aspect is particularly critical in Eulerian SPH, where particles are stationary throughout the simulation.

arxiv-2411-09405.title: Magnetic dipole moments of the singly-heavy baryons with spin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} and spin- 3 2 \frac{3}{2}
arxiv-2411-09405.creator: Ulaş Özdem
arxiv-2411-09405.description: Abstract The electromagnetic characteristics of singly-heavy baryons at low energies are responsive to their internal composition, structural configuration, and the associated chiral dynamics of light diquarks. To gain further insight, experimentalists are attempting to measure the magnetic and electric dipole moments of charm baryons at the LHC.

arxiv-2411-15457.title: Hindi audio-video-Deepfake (HAV-DF): A Hindi language-based Audio-video Deepfake Dataset
arxiv-2411-15457.creator: Sukhandeep Kaur, Mubashir Buhari, Naman Khandelwal, Priyansh Tyagi, Kiran Sharma
arxiv-2411-15457.description: Abstract Deepfakes, while technologically impressive, present a dual-edged sword. On the one hand, they have potential for innovation and creativity. However, their misuse poses significant risks to privacy, trust, and security, making it essential to develop detection tools and ethical frameworks to mitigate harm. With a vast Hindi-speaking population, India is particularly vulnerable to deepfake-driven misinformation campaigns.

arxiv-2502-14446.title: LEIT-motifs: Scalable Motif Mining in Multidimensional Time Series
arxiv-2502-14446.creator: Matteo Ceccarello, Francesco Pio Monaco, Francesco Silvestri
arxiv-2502-14446.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matteo Ceccarello, Francesco Pio Monaco, Francesco Silvestri. Time series play a fundamental role in many domains, capturing a plethora of information about the underlying data-generating processes. When a process generates multiple synchronized signals we are faced with multidimensional time series. In this context a fundamental problem is that of motif mining , where we seek patterns repeating twice with minor variations, spanning some of the dimensions.

arxiv-2508-18123.title: Views : A Hardware-friendly Graph Database Model For Storing Semantic Information Preprint. Not submitted. Not peer-reviewed.
arxiv-2508-18123.creator: Yanjun Yang, Adrian Wheeldon, Yihan Pan, Alex Serb
arxiv-2508-18123.description: Abstract The gdb ( gdb ) is an increasingly common storage model for data involving relationships between entries. Beyond its widespread usage in database industries, the advantages of gdb indicate a strong potential in constructing symbolic ai and rag ( rag ), where knowledge of data inter-relationships takes a critical role in implementation.

britannica-1911-kiang-su.title: Kiang-su (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-kiang-su.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-kiang-su.description: Article 'Kiang-su' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. It has an area of 45,000 sq. m., and a population estimated at 21,000,000. Kiang-su forms part of the great plain of northern China. There are no mountains within its limits, and few hills. It is watered as no other province in China is watered.

pmc-10496357.title: “Why involve older people in research?” Revisiting Alan Walker’s earlier editorial based on recent experiences from the UserAge research programme
pmc-10496357.creator: Sara Hultqvist, Elizabeth Hanson, Håkan Jönson, Björn Slaug, Susanne Iwarsson
pmc-10496357.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Posed 16 years ago in a much-cited editorial by gerontologist, Alan Walker, “Why involve older people in research?” is a question that has since inspired researchers in many countries and from diverse disciplines. In Sweden, researchers and older people have been collaborating in the 6-year UserAge research programme, focusing on user involvement in research on ageing and health, UserAge aims at contributing to an in-depth understanding of the challenges and benefits of user involvement in different phases of the research process.

pmc-11402623.title: Tumor perfusion enhancement by focus ultrasound-induced blood-brain barrier opening to potentiate anti-PD-1 immunotherapy of glioma
pmc-11402623.creator: Haiyan Shan, Guangrong Zheng, Shasha Bao, Haiyan Yang, Ujen Duwal Shrestha, Guochen Li, Xirui Duan, Xiaolan Du, Tengfei Ke, Chengde Liao
pmc-11402623.description: Highlights•FUS combined with microbubbles can promote the opening of BBB and increase the infiltration of T lymphocytes.•The combination of FUS and PD-1 inhibitors significantly enhances tumor T-cell infiltration, delays tumor progression, and prolongs survival.•Focused ultrasound therapy can promote the blood perfusion of the tumor, change the hypoxic environment of the tumor, and inhibit the growth of the tumor.

pmc-11457359.creator: Monruedee Sukprasansap, Pithi Chanvorachote, Tewin Tencomnao

The authors were unable to provide raw data for this figure upon request by the Publisher. The Editor therefore no longer has confidence in this article’s findings or conclusions.

pmc-11480711.title: The genome sequence of the Essex Skipper butterfly, Thymelicus lineola (Ochsenheimer, 1808)
pmc-11480711.creator: Konrad Lohse, Roger Vila, Alex Hayward, Dominik R. Laetsch, Simon Harnqvist, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Management, Samples and Laboratory team, Wellcome Sanger Institute Scientific Operations: Sequencing Operations, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Core Informatics team, Tree of L
pmc-11480711.description: We present a genome assembly from an individual female Essex Skipper butterfly, Thymelicus lineola (Arthropoda; Insecta; Lepidoptera; Hesperiidae). The genome sequence spans 511.80 megabases. Most of the assembly is scaffolded into 30 chromosomal pseudomolecules, including the Z and W sex chromosomes. The mitochondrial genome has also been assembled and is 17.24 kilobases in length.

pmc-11520879.title: Periodontal disease and cardiovascular disease: umbrella review
pmc-11520879.creator: Heber Isac Arbildo-Vega, Fredy Hugo Cruzado-Oliva, Franz Tito Coronel-Zubiate, Joan Manuel Meza-Málaga, Sara Antonieta Luján-Valencia, Eduardo Luján-Urviola, Adriana Echevarria-Goche, Carlos Alberto Farje-Gallardo, Tania Belú Castillo-Cornock, Katherine Serquen-Olano, Tania Padilla-Cáceres, Luz Caba
pmc-11520879.description: BackgroundPeriodontal disease (PD) is an infectious and inflammatory condition that affects the tissues surrounding and supporting the teeth. It has been suggested that PD may be associated with cardiovascular disease (CVD), one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Our study aimed to investigate the association between PD and CVD through an umbrella review.

pmc-12581420.title: Understanding causes of incomplete reports of adverse drug reactions associated with dolutegravir-based HIV treatment in uganda: a qualitative study
pmc-12581420.creator: Henry Zakumumpa, Helen Byomire Ndagije, Joanitah Atuhaire, Julius Mayengo, Francis Odipiyo, Kiguba Ronald
pmc-12581420.description: IntroductionAlthough dolutegravir (DTG)-based HIV treatment has demonstrated superior efficacy, it has been associated with adverse drug reactions (ADRs). Robust pharmacovigilance systems that ensure that received ADRs reports are complete and accurate facilitate timely regulatory decision making. However, there is little research seeking to understand the contexts underpinning data capture of DTG- associated ADRs.

pmc-12691868.title: Enhancing Medical Diagnosis Document Analysis with Layout-Aware Multitask Models
pmc-12691868.creator: Hung-Jen Tu, Jia-Lien Hsu
pmc-12691868.description: Background and Objectives: Medical diagnosis documents often exhibit diverse layouts and formats, posing significant challenges for automated information extraction. Ensuring the privacy of sensitive medical data further complicates the development of effective analysis systems. This study aims to develop a robust and privacy-compliant system for analyzing medical diagnosis documents.

pmc-12987057.title: From Design to Application: Advanced Cellulose Scaffolds for Engineered Tissue Regeneration
pmc-12987057.creator: Yao Tong, Yong Cai, Yanting Wu, Wenkun Zhuo, Jinfeng Liao
pmc-12987057.description: The regeneration of complex tissues demands advanced scaffolds that offer biomimetic support and tissue-specific bioactive guidance. However, the materials in clinic face big challenges with immune rejection, limited donors, and unsatisfactory inductive activity. Fortunately, cellulose-based scaffolds have risen as a leading sustainable platform, considering their natural abundance, inherent biocompatibility, and highly tunable properties.

pmc-13179365.title: Computational engineering of the polyester hydrolase PHL7 for efficient poly(ethylene terephthalate) degradation in biocatalytic recycling processes
pmc-13179365.creator: Paula Blázquez-Sánchez, Jonas Gunkel, Abibe Useini, Alexander Zlobin, Jonathan D. Zakary, Andrea Schöler, Norbert Graefe, Felipe Engelberger, Filipa Cantanhede, Ronny Frank, Ziyue Zhao, Afsaneh Zarei, Erik Butenschön, Jörg Matysik, Wolfgang Zimmermann, Norbert Sträter, Christian Sonnendecker, Georg
pmc-13179365.description: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic waste causes serious environmental pollution due to insufficient recycling rates. Enzymatic PET depolymerization offers a sustainable recycling strategy, but limited stability and activity of current PET-degrading enzymes restrict practical implementation. Here, we engineer Polyester Hydrolase Leipzig 7 (PHL7), a PET hydrolase from a compost metagenome, to enhance its stability and catalytic performance under recycling-relevant conditions.

pmc-13326486.title: Overexpression of the EfMYB124 gene from Erianthus fulvus enhances tolerance to low temperature and drought in Arabidopsis thaliana
pmc-13326486.creator: Xibing Rao, Lilian He, Zhenfeng Qian, Qingqing Shen, Zhengying Luo, Jun Zhao, Fusheng Li

pmc-13327610.title: Rapid and quantitative phage susceptibility test by ramanome
pmc-13327610.creator: Xiao Han, Xiaofu Wan, Yang Zhou, Xiaoting Fu, Xiaoshan Zheng, Bo Gao, Shi Huang, Anle Ge, Jiadong Huang, Hongzhou Lu, Jian Xu
pmc-13327610.description: Antimicrobial resistance poses an escalating global threat, renewing interest in bacteriophage therapy as a precision alternative to antibiotics. However, clinical translation remains hindered by the lack of rapid and quantitative phage susceptibility testing (PST) platforms capable of evaluating host range, infection potency, and effective multiplicity of infection (MOI).

pmc-13454262.title: Autism spectrum disorder identification using machine learning models on MRI data
pmc-13454262.creator: Milner Paul V, Caren Babu, Suni Jose, Shuma Adhikari, Loitongbam Surajkumar Singh, Jijo Francis, Adarsh V Parekkattil
pmc-13454262.description: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition that affects sensory processing, speech, behavior and identifying the condition at an early stage is necessary to provide the treatment. The existing diagnostic methods are mainly based on personalized subjective and time consuming.

pmc-13543445.title: The Hypoxia Trap: Worsening Sickle Cell Disease in the Setting of Tetralogy of Fallot
pmc-13543445.creator: Mohnish Darshan, Sonal Rajmane, Jignesh Sharma, Amber Kumar, Girish Chandra Bhatt, Shikha Malik
pmc-13543445.description: BackgroundTetralogy of Fallot (TOF) is the most common cyanotic congenital heart disease and predisposes affected children to thrombotic complications due to chronic hypoxia and polycythemia. Sickle cell disease (SCD) further increases the risk of vaso-occlusion through erythrocyte sickling and endothelial dysfunction.
